limitations: Slower than known O(N log N) comparator. Child D2 has three nonzeros/row, so pretending it is same two-sparse family is false.

title: q-kernel bounded rational-degree obstruction
inherited_proof_status: Accepted via nonzero q-factorial Hankel minors and reciprocal case.
limitations: High-degree sparse factors or different noncommuting operators may be cheap; tail fusion is a positive counterexample to degree→time inference.

title: Whole-orbit q-kernel compression and minimum cycle-flow compiler
inherited_proof_status: Accepted exact all-input graph rewrite when input word has prescribed structure.
limitations: Fourier factorization does not automatically contain that word. Intervening noncommuting maps, independent inputs or omitted signed corrections invalidate replacement; no universal algorithm.

title: Fixed q-Pascal Fourier factorization and cheap recurrences
inherited_proof_status: Accepted supporting identities; exact boundaries matter.
limitations: A compact polynomial or fixed kernel is not an O(N) application oracle. All changed child actions and terminal decoders remain charged.

title: Randomized Gaussian-padded all-length approximation
inherited_proof_status: Independent theorem audit supports asymptotics; number theory unconditional. Finite-word implementation not certified.
limitations: Tolerance exceeds typical dense-spectrum bin scale by N^(1/2−alpha). No endpoint alpha=1/2, no relative per-bin/l2 approximation. Prototype fixed seed is not fresh randomness; sampler repair is theoretical; overflow/NaN and rounding guards incomplete.

title: Elementary rough padding and covariance sharpening
inherited_proof_status: Accepted supporting lemma for Gaussian path.
limitations: Does not produce a faster exact FFT; finite-size threshold and base coefficient model still matter.

title: Fully charged fixed-error packed approximate outputs
inherited_proof_status: Constructive proof completed by audit; whole asymptotic evaluator not benchmarked, only components executed historically.
limitations: Possibly enormous threshold/constants. Not arbitrary floating exponent range, exact output, per-bin relative error, vanishing epsilon without reanalysis, or stable full FFT.

title: Shrinking-error packed finite-word evaluator
inherited_proof_status: Accepted qualified theorem; full asymptotic evaluator remains design, prototype is toy/components.
limitations: Weak coordinatewise mass scale can permit all-zero answers for diffuse random signs. No vanishing relative l2 error. Saturation lower bound is only this full packed-row evaluator, not all approximation algorithms.

title: Sparse time-surrogate sampling and head/tail planning
inherited_proof_status: Base theorem accepted with later planner corrections; stale/cross-input plans are invalid.
limitations: Use relative decay assumptions; vanishing multiplier need not give vanishing absolute error. Repeated whole-input selection can lose claimed cost. Planning must bind actual input/tolerance; source code has stale-state hazards.

title: Quantized stage-template Fourier tabulation
inherited_proof_status: Exact stage identity and scoped approximate analysis accepted; source tests only finite evidence.
limitations: Exact intermediate alphabet grows. A bottom-leaf-only table leaves Theta(N log(N/K)); polynomial binary tables force K=O(log N).

title: Deterministic energy-pruned transform
inherited_proof_status: Accepted approximation theorem. Prototype has unproved finite-precision decisions.
limitations: Coarse scale may output all zeros on diffuse spectra. Naive binary64 norms underflow/overflow; no robust arbitrary-input NumPy advantage established.

title: Strong-scale head/tail pruning counterexample
inherited_proof_status: Accepted exact algorithm-specific negative result.
limitations: Additional phase structure, other backends or altered intermediate representation outside proof. Native instruction counts not inferred.

title: Affine-chirp sketch exact decoder
inherited_proof_status: Accepted decoder of sketch, not exact original DFT.
limitations: Nonunit/gcd and phase period guards matter. Faster common-slope factorization cannot be advertised for arbitrary varying slopes.

title: Chirp-sketch collisions and decoder failures
inherited_proof_status: Accepted exact collision obstruction; 2Mth-root CAZAC phase removes this collision but natural adjoint has separate failure.
limitations: Changing measurements or adding raw input leaves model; repaired phase does not validate adjoint decoder.

title: Direct composite covariance and false adaptive certificate
inherited_proof_status: Theorem accepted; implementation certificate demonstrably false.
limitations: Quantized three-grid aggregation is not median. Missing deterministic addition error and differing chosen M break guarantee. Prime-square vs semiprime cases must separate; older mask bound may be stronger.

title: Direct unequal-block all-length recurrence route
inherited_proof_status: Algebraic scoped statements survive; actual numeric and helper defects recorded.
limitations: Six failures include huge error and infinities; row-count helper for p in[1/4,1/2) overflows before cap because bound does not decay. These failures do not refute Gaussian padded theorem.

title: Complete exact phase-frame collapse
inherited_proof_status: Accepted known identity, not exact fast upgrade.
limitations: Constant-row approximation cannot become exact by uncharged full frame. Physical block map singular values differ from normalized summary map; no hidden free recovered inputs.

title: Gaussian measurement-rank strong-accuracy barrier
inherited_proof_status: Accepted all-size probability proof, scope corrected.
limitations: No alpha=1/2 conclusion. Arbitrary rank deficit alone insufficient: random omission of one coordinate is countercontrol. Does not conflict with alpha<1/2 approximation.

title: Input-independent linear-sketch strong-scale rank barrier
inherited_proof_status: Accepted scoped barrier.
limitations: Does not exclude v4 importance sampling (input dependent) or v6 coordinate median (nonlinear).

title: Residual-certified finite-word Green/median bridge
inherited_proof_status: Implemented bridge components and compositional theorem accepted; Fourier/decoder in bridge tests are test-only oracles.
limitations: Not end-to-end implemented linear-time FFT, exact output, or practical speed claim. Zero residual after median does not erase source/target rounding errors.

title: Marked-tree constant-input jets and forbidden-run frontiers
inherited_proof_status: Accepted scoped jet/frontier theorem.
limitations: Recursively produced polynomial right-hand sides require coefficient convolution not charged by constant-input proof. Separate invertibility guards fail: explicit finite-field counterexamples require coupled Schur guard.

title: Weighted marker-cut source preparation
inherited_proof_status: Accepted identity/source improvement with unresolved retained solve.
limitations: No closed faster Fourier recurrence. Cancellation/depathing must count free-boundary source costs rather than assuming independent packet work.

title: Bounded-coefficient exposed-source packet obstruction
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts model-scoped lower bound.
limitations: Row normalization destroys this determinant witness; arbitrary coefficient gains or different source interfaces escape. Exact alias identities do not causally compute future states.

title: Normalized packets reduce to selected Fourier outputs
inherited_proof_status: Accepted after independent normalized audit.
limitations: No free historical output tape or nonunitary gates in unitary lower bound. Normalized rows have all minors <=1, so earlier determinant proof cannot be reused.

title: Selected-convolution structure and local compression gates
inherited_proof_status: Construction and independent escape audit accepted within stated interfaces.
limitations: Blocks require >=Q channels in stated balanced local model; no short stencil/bounded quasiseparability/single sparse inverse with monomial ends. General Cauchy fast multiplication and changing interfaces remain allowed.

title: Shared inverse root packets and routed correction
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit supports exact identity and scoped rank/uncertainty gates.
limitations: Some root packet sums collapse to one O(N) stride solve, but not Fourier. Approximation support-t gate is eta sqrt(max(0,1−t/N)), eta=(1−|a|^r)/(1+|a|^r), in operator and normalized Frobenius norms.

title: Monomial Weyl-interface normal form
inherited_proof_status: Accepted classification/constructor with orientation corrections.
limitations: Necessary normal form, not unrestricted converse or cheap application. Supplied action arrays are genuine side information.

title: Metaplectic Bruhat word compiler
inherited_proof_status: Accepted classical normal form with paid word read and scalar.
limitations: Does not make the remaining Fourier cheap or show every matrix has this grammar.

title: Two-line Weyl product and Fourier-hard factor
inherited_proof_status: Independent review accepts corrected phase/sign conventions.
limitations: No general arithmetic lower bound; only specified two-line factors.

title: Bounded-norm and low-rank Green-stage budgets
inherited_proof_status: Accepted model-specific norm arguments.
limitations: Growing strength, arbitrary magnitude diagonals, changed primitives or fused execution escape. No universal Fourier lower bound.

title: Forward and opposite-sign Green-cycle spectral gates
inherited_proof_status: Accepted classification/spectral argument with N=2 exception.
limitations: Long mixed words need not decompose into locally unitary pairs. Arbitrary gains, global cancellation or fusion beyond grammar not excluded. Literal one fixed commuting operator cannot be flat at any depth; broader phase-rotated case has its separate short-word gate.

title: Whole-word rational degree and scan-broadcast gates
inherited_proof_status: Accepted scoped whole-word and routed sequential-state obstructions.
limitations: Changing geometry/nonlocal auxiliary ports or uncharged retained transcripts escape the rational model. Full-array pass charging required for time conclusions.

title: Adaptive and nonlinear linearization gate
inherited_proof_status: Accepted scoped algebraic linearization.
limitations: Boolean finite domains have no open-set argument; branch finding or zero denominator cannot be assumed away.

title: Boolean spectral completion and joint Galois stability boundaries
inherited_proof_status: Accepted scoped algebraic/rank and stability gates; finite examples not asymptotic proof.
limitations: Higher-degree/rational decoders, direct raw input, exact integer coefficients or stronger side information remain outside measured-information lower bound.

title: Learned dense and rational Green-cycle innovations
inherited_proof_status: Accepted promised recurrence synthesis; randomized verification is not deterministic certification.
limitations: Late impulse can pass prefix; R sampled checks have explicit field failure probability and cannot be called exact deterministic membership. Capacity q^(2d), not a bijection onto all streams. Finite root setup omissions remain implementation caveats.

title: Exact binary NTT and affine-alphabet extension
inherited_proof_status: Two independent audits accept theorem with explicit imported Frobenius machinery.
limitations: Full output has Theta(Nlog N) bits. No bit-complexity breakthrough; huge constants, no practical win proved; alphabet cardinality alone does not imply logarithmic affine dimension.

title: Conditional conditioned macro-FFT and mass-contraction compiler
inherited_proof_status: Valid conditional composition and recurrence analysis; missing structural compiler remains unproved.
limitations: GFC4 Green/four-layer/partial-Fourier bank compiler not constructed. External OpenAI exact-register algorithm is prior work and its own model, not automatically this stable primitive.

title: Fixed-bank transport and active-bank decoding
inherited_proof_status: Accepted within stated bank geometry.
limitations: Original odd-k m<q regime is not proved by square/fixed-radix extension. Cannot replace missing first P call by cached data.

title: Young-feedback arbitrary-jet obstruction
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts all-size component theorem.
limitations: Original-source-generated jets have only N independent inputs and are not the arbitrary-jet interface. No finite-field, nonlinear, packed-word, unbounded-coefficient or general FFT lower bound.

title: Changed bank interface and four-character channel identities
inherited_proof_status: Audits accept identities, finite N=16 zero-mask control and original-orientation distinctions.
limitations: Cheap G does not imply cheap bank conjugate. Finite full-bank N=16 construction not scalable solution. Different arbitrary input residues still require separate child applications.

title: Root-exchange CRT bridges and sparse spectral projectors
inherited_proof_status: Independent audits accept exact identities and corrected interface meanings.
limitations: Filtered time-domain vector is not full spectrum. Correction rank does not imply scalar cost lower bound. Binary-mask-only label recovery needs >=log2N masks and explicitly materialized outputs NlogN, not general complexity.

title: Green-union sparse-inverse and low-rank gate
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts theorem; uploaded modulation implementation has repeated-power Theta(Nlog N) flaw, repaired with running table.
limitations: Branch sums, shared evaluators and high-support inverses outside. Dense/full-rank/full-commutator does not establish hardness. Orbit fusion computes a different stride Green operator, not DFT.

title: Trace sieve and short-probe sparse-rational recognizer
inherited_proof_status: Independent audits accept sieve/enumeration and coverage improvement, conditional on inherited nonzero-resultant and Green guards.
limitations: Vanished probes/resultant and nonlinear gamma gcd can decline valid inputs. Tonelli–Shanks nonresidue and O(log p+v2(p−1)²) cost not free; complete subgroup scan avoids this. Legacy root-table undercharge not on new active path.

title: Delta-Graph and spectral Newton-union recognition
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts theorem and independently repaired reset-union completeness.
limitations: Shipped greedy multi-anchor misses N=16 witness; fixed divisor/order misses other valid splits. Uploaded fused dispatcher never invokes new branches; certificate helpers trust metadata. No generic-input transform theorem.

title: All-parameter nearby-permutation geometric transform
inherited_proof_status: Independent positive repair accepted; source nonsingular Woodbury bound becomes O(N(s+1)²+s³).
limitations: Uploaded z^N=1 branch excludes valid inputs; unpermuted-character shortcut invalid after arbitrary permutation. Zero-defect source repeated exponentiation is Theta(Nlog N), repaired by hoisting.

title: Root-free rank-two and real-Fourier Green queries
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts identities and broader root-free recurrence extension.
limitations: Leading Hankel rank alone insufficient; late impulse counterexample. Binary coverage exponentially small. Full recurrence class broader than uploaded distinct split-node detector.

title: Orthogonal-bank projectors and fixed-frame recovery
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts exact identity, minimax correction and conditioning refinement.
limitations: Coordinate leverage sqrt(1−q/M) is not minimax over all inputs. Adaptive sketch-only zero transcript needs >=M rank-N/M observations; direct raw reads outside. No near-subspace numerical membership certificate.

title: Norm-certified finite-word tabulated FFT
inherited_proof_status: New full paper proof survives two independent read-only reviews at fixed epsilon; no supplied code execution. General merely computable precision schedule must be qualified by its computation cost.
limitations: Dyadic only. At polynomially small accuracy block size constant and saving disappears. Prototype high-precision tests generate entries on demand and force inadmissible small-N radices; toy eager tables only, no production benchmark or complete implementation verification.

title: CRT-15 all-input codelet circuit
inherited_proof_status: New theorem and cost ledger read statically, classical identity consistent; reported tests not rerun.
limitations: No asymptotic improvement. Finite comparisons cannot substitute for generic root availability or bit analysis. OpenAI challenge placeholder is not evidence that its separate solution proof is absent/invalid.

title: Free-boundary cancellation and marked-cycle unresolved inverse
inherited_proof_status: Accepted failed-route/accounting theorem and conditional scalar-circuit reduction.
limitations: No fast marked scalar circuit or new retained inverse supplied. Individual chart pivots may vanish despite full invertibility; z=omega explicit counterexample.

title: Correction-graph rational and multi-parent product reuse
inherited_proof_status: Independent reviews accept after signed-buffer length guard correction.
limitations: Both-affine products require three seeds, not two. Relation discovery and planning paid; corrupt anchor not authenticated by metadata. Scalar scheduler objective not bit-cost optimum.

title: Sparse edits, low-rank batches and persistent convolution
inherited_proof_status: Accepted classical identities; historical performance reports not freshly rerun.
limitations: No free basis/rank recognition, input read, cache population, subscriptions, stale keys, memory or first transform. Wrong cross-term omission when both operands change gives incorrect output.

title: Cache rewrite engine, real FFT packing and native optimization
inherited_proof_status: Known engineering; uploaded tests/benchmarks historical only, no current execution.
limitations: Two arbitrary complex inputs cannot be injectively linearly packed into one same-sized complex vector. Tuned real FFT baseline may beat packing. Float cancellation, dtype/stride guards, stale plans and empirical crossover must be checked.

title: Structured exact integer products and prime-free backend
inherited_proof_status: Independent reviews accept after input-iterator fix; full field/bit model explicit.
limitations: Elementary general backend not asymptotically competitive. Coefficient convolution wider than digits. Cached numerical vs coefficient formats have different bit widths; scalar MST not bit-optimal.

title: Approximate-to-exact integer rounding gate
inherited_proof_status: Independent review accepts normalization/error derivation and scoped negative bridge; exhausted-iterator bug repaired.
limitations: Monte-Carlo confidence is not verification of this run or Las Vegas correctness. One coefficient error is not repaired by carry. Better correlated errors/modular methods remain possible.

title: Synthetic WHT, cancellation search and finite-width controls
inherited_proof_status: Retained finite exact/conditional engineering results; broad novelty not claimed.
limitations: Conditional saving 4.986133e−5 does not construct missing scalable core. Finite exact-width obstruction is specific topology, not all circuits.

title: Thin rectangular multiplication source and compiler gate
inherited_proof_status: Source-access boundary, unranked; no negative theorem inferred from missing text.
limitations: 1978 errata fully read historically; 1976 construction and thesis remain access gaps. Do not invent exact addition circuit or rule out result.

title: Frequency-shift sketches, nonlinear median and energy adaptation
inherited_proof_status: Accepted variance/minimax and scoped measurement barrier; earlier approximate precursor.
limitations: Deficient fixed linear measurements cannot recover all continuous inputs; stronger almost-everywhere inputwise statement needs measurability. Does not apply to input-adaptive raw reads or finite discrete sets.

title: All-length Chebyshev/Bessel and rational-Taylor lifts
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit supports exact identities and repairs conditional error contract; not NumPy/SciPy certification.
limitations: Original full-row error contract insufficient for separately rounded summaries. Higher expansion rank does not evade information rank. All-length padded outputs require correct interpolation and normalization.

title: Joint universal-orbit and compiled q-grid application
inherited_proof_status: Independent reviews accept identities, linear preparation improvement and application accounting.
limitations: Input kernel identity is not a free arbitrary-input solve: a(z)/a(eta z) may not exist, and a(z)=z counterexample. Grid zero multipliers save only O(M) products; common-anchor/growing-radix exclusions remain interface-specific. Exponential orbit conditioning affects finite precision.

inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts scheduling mathematics, reports concrete API/domain defects.
limitations: Green constructor can reject invertible N16/GF17 due zero diagonal. Calling full then preview produces wrong DC unless guard repaired; intended preview then full valid. Generic input gets detector overhead.

title: High-arity and nonunitary gate tolls
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts scoped classical tolls and field counts.
limitations: No finite-field transfer of magnitude lower bounds, no unrestricted arithmetic lower bound, no reason arbitrary growing-arity Fourier gate costs one scalar operation.

title: Original aggregate-fiber linear theorem
inherited_proof_status: Independent audit accepts all-input recognition cost and accepted-class output.
limitations: No generic dense-input speedup; growing-budget theorem in ALG-002 is separate, not uniformly better. Full input read contract requires explicit scan before early rejection.
